answers.q1: A meeting recording has just started (00:02 elapsed, out of what looks like a 2:58 meeting). The app is listening to the microphone and system audio but hasn't captured any speech yet, so the transcript, decisions, and action items are all still empty placeholders.
answers.q2: The recording status itself: the red dot and '録音中 00:02' timer confirm it is actively recording, paired with '聞いています...' confirming it is listening for audio right now.
answers.q3: I can pause or stop the recording, expand the floating control bar, open chat/comment or fullscreen from the top toolbar, switch between 文字起こし/翻訳/字幕 tabs, or type a question into 'この会議について聞く' at the bottom.
answers.q4: Not really yet — there's a status line saying it's listening and an animated dots indicator, but since no actual words have appeared in 2 seconds, I have no direct proof it's transcribing correctly. I'd need to hear it produce real text to be confident.
answers.q5: The four bottom-right buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are all grayed out/disabled and the 'AI が見ている資料 — まだありません' footer is telling me about materials that don't exist yet — these all feel like premature clutter this early in the recording.
answers.q6: The floating black pill toolbar at the top center, because of its dark contrast against the light background and its central position, with the red recording dot and red stop button drawing extra attention.

weaknesses.what: At 2 seconds in, every panel just says 'waiting' with no live signal (e.g. audio level, partial word) that speech is actually being captured, so a first-time user has no way to confirm recording is working besides the static status text.
weaknesses.fix: Show a live mic/audio-level indicator or the first partial transcript fragment as soon as sound is detected, so the listening state feels verifiably active.

weaknesses.what: Four action buttons (リアルタイム要約, 質問する, 決定事項, アクション) are all disabled with nothing to act on yet, adding visual clutter without offering any usable function this early.
weaknesses.fix: Hide or visually de-emphasize these buttons until there is enough transcript/content for them to be meaningful.

weaknesses.what: The whole screen is gray/monochrome placeholder text with only a dotted animation for motion, giving no sense of the app being alive or responsive.
weaknesses.fix: Add a subtle accent color or micro-animation (e.g. a gentle pulse on the recording dot or a soft waveform) to make the listening state feel more alive.
